_doc: Profiles. Public fields render on people.html and the press kit. 'review' and 'sources' are internal. A portrait renders only if 'portrait.file' exists under src/assets AND 'portrait.authorised' is true. 'disclosures' renders only when non-empty and sourced. Interview modules render only when complete (see interviews.json).

people.name: Dr Scott W. Woods
people.role: Adviser on clinical high risk of psychosis
responsibilities: Advises the programme on clinical high risk of psychosis: how the condition is identified and how studies in this group should be designed.
affiliations: Professor of Psychiatry, Yale School of Medicine
Director, PRIME Clinic, which specialises in people at clinical high risk of psychosis
people.bio: Psychiatrist and researcher who has worked for many years on identifying and helping young people at clinical high risk of psychosis.
people.review: Formal title with the programme unconfirmed (teaser lists him under leadership as 'Yale PRIME; CHR-P authority'). Bio sentence pending round-2 verification of CHR-P research leadership.

people.name: Dr John M. Kane
responsibilities: Chairs the programme's Scientific Advisory Board.
affiliations: Professor of Psychiatry and Molecular Medicine, Donald and Barbara Zucker School of Medicine at Hofstra/Northwell
Co-director, Institute for Behavioral Science, Feinstein Institutes for Medical Research
people.bio: Psychiatrist and schizophrenia researcher with long experience of leading clinical trials.
people.review: Early-intervention research statement pending round-2 verification (RAISE).

people.name: Dr Grace Blest-Hopley
responsibilities: Responsible for the programme's scientific strategy as Chief Scientific Officer.
people.bio: Neuroscientist specialising in cannabinoid neuropharmacology. PhD from King's College London on the actions and effects of cannabinoids.
people.review: Specific responsibility for formulation research not documented; do not state it until confirmed.

people.name: Filipp Korentsvit
people.role: Chief Executive Officer and Founding Partner
responsibilities: Leads company strategy and the development programme.
people.bio: Previously an Executive Director at Goldman Sachs. BSc in Economics and Statistics, University College London.

people.name: Daud Gutseriev
people.bio: Previously an Associate Director at VTB Capital in infrastructure and project financing. Executive MBA, University of Oxford Saïd Business School.

people.name: William Jarosz
responsibilities: Chairs the board; focuses on biotech partnerships.
people.bio: Business leader with a background in finance and the pharmaceutical industry. JD, Harvard Law School; MA in Law and Diplomacy, Tufts University.
people.review: Teaser lists both Jarosz (Executive Chairman) and Barker (Non-Executive Chairman). Confirm titles.

people.name: Professor Richard Barker OBE
people.bio: Director General of the Association of the British Pharmaceutical Industry (ABPI) from 2004 to 2011, former Chief Executive of Chiron, and former non-executive director of Celgene.

people.name: Dr Gillian Cannon
people.bio: Pharmaceutical executive with senior roles at Merck, Otsuka and UCB.
